data.name: Khairi
data.gender_notes: Khairi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is good, kind, beautiful, and pure in nature. A handsome and virtuous person. The name Khairi carries the meaning “Good, Pure, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Khairi usually hope their child will grow to embody good, pure, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner goodness and purity of an individual. Encourages kindness and good deeds.
data.etymology: Khairi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Pure, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khairi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خيري
in_arabic.meaning: خير و خوبی کا داتا، نیک و فلاح دین
in_arabic.long_meaning: خيري نام کا مطلب ہے خیر و خوبی کا داتا، نیک و فلاح دین۔ یہ نام خیر کے معنی میں ہے جو قرآن مجید میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصولی جڑ خیر ہے جو عربی زبان میں خیر و خوبی کے معنی میں ہے۔

in_urdu.name: خیری

in_hindi.name: खैरी
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैर और अच्छी तरह देने वाला, नेक और धार्मिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: खैरी नाम का अर्थ है ख़ैर और अच्छी तरह देने वाला, नेक और धार्मिक। यह नाम अरबी जड़ ख़ैर से बना है जिसका अर्थ है ख़ैर और अच्छाई। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम पारंपरिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: خیري
in_pashto.meaning: د خیر او نیکۍ ورکوونکی، دیني او ښه سړی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خیري نوم معنی د خیر او نیکۍ ورکوونکی، دیني او ښه سړی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د اصلي ريښې خير څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د خیر او نیکۍ معنی ورکوي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې دا نوم مهم کلتوري ارزښت لري.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khairi is deeply rooted in Islamic culture and represents values of kindness, generosity, and beautiful character traits. In the Islamic community, calling someone Khairi is a high form of compliment and signifies admiration for their good nature and virtuous qualities. It is a common name for both boys and girls and is often used as a term of endearment among family and friends.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Khairi holds deep spiritual significance as it highlights the importance of living a good and virtuous life in line with Islamic teachings and values. Khairi is not just a name, but also a reminder to live a life filled with kindness, good deeds, and virtue. It is a name that inspires one to be a source of positivity and goodness in the world, striving to be a blessing to others and improving themselves spiritually. It serves as a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) words, "The best among you are those who have the best manners and character." (Sahih Bukhari, Hadith 7.151) thus, living up to the name Khairi is not only a desirable cultural trait but also a deeply spiritual one.

historical_references.context: Ibn Khair was a prominent Andalusian scholar, jurist, physician, philosopher, and poet. He is perhaps best known for his works in Islamic jurisprudence, particularly his commentary on Imam Malik's Muwatta. He was also a prolific writer and is considered one of the major figures in Andalusian literature.

historical_references.context: Sayyid Ahmad Shahid Khairi was a prominent Pakistani Islamic scholar, writer, and politician. Khairi was a proponent of Islamic social justice and advocated for the implementation of Islamic law in Pakistan.
